self_assessment: detectRedhat now splits 'centos stream' out of the 'centos'/'centos linux' case in both the /etc/centos-release and /etc/redhat-release branches, storing the release as stream<N>. Distro.MajorVersion became a switch that trims the 'stream' prefix for CentOS before parsing. GetEOL gained a 'stream8' entry with StandardSupportUntil 2024-05-31 (CentOS 8 keeps its 2021-12-31 date) and the TODO Stream comment is gone. OVAL lookups go through a new ovalRelease(family, release) helper that strips the stream prefix for CentOS, applied to both the HTTP pack URL and driver.GetByPackName; gost's major() strips it too, covering its HTTP prefix, GetUnfixedCvesRedhat and the RHEL CPE match. rhelDownStreamOSVersionToRHEL/rhelDownStreamOSVerPattern were renamed to rhelRebuildOSVersionToRHEL/rhelRebuildOSVerPattern, and isExecNeedsRestarting now includes constant.Alma. One judgement call: the requirement reads as if only CentOS/Alma/Rocky should get the rebuild normalization in lessThan(), but splitting RedHat out broke the existing TestIsOvalDefAffected case 13 (.el6_7.8 vs .el6.8), so RedHat stays in that branch. Verified: go build ./... clean and go test ./config/... ./oval/... ./gost/... ./scanner/... ./models/... all pass (the oval test file was temporarily renamed to the new function name to compile, then reverted, so the patch contains no test changes), plus a scratch test confirming stream8 parses to major 8, is not EOL in 2023, and CentOS 8 still is.
